plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.À ce stade, il établit et maintient la l: At this stage it establishes and holds the link, and shows the daemon and broker states above. Automatic device discovery — Shelly, Tasmota, Zigbee2MQTT, Home Assistant Discovery — comes with the next milestone: no device is created yet, and this page stays empty until then.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Les deux pastilles disent des choses dif: The two badges say different things: the daemon can run while the broker does not answer, and the address, the port or the credentials are then where to look.

IP address or host name of the MQTT broker. This is the only setting you really need.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.1883 en clair, 8883 en TLS. Ce sont les: 1883 in the clear, 8883 over TLS. These are the customary ports, not a requirement.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.À laisser vide si le broker accepte les: Leave empty if the broker accepts anonymous connections.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.MQTT transmet le mot de passe en clair h: MQTT sends the password in the clear without TLS: on a shared network, turn on encryption below.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Silence toléré par le broker avant qu'il: How long the broker tolerates silence before declaring the connection dead. The daemon sends it a sign of life within that delay.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Pensez à changer le port : un broker en: Remember to change the port: a TLS broker rarely listens on 1883.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Chemin d'un fichier CA sur la machine Je: Path to a CA file on the Jeedom machine, needed if the broker certificate is not signed by a public authority. Left empty, the system authorities apply.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Le chiffrement reste actif, mais l'ident: Encryption stays on, but the broker identity is no longer checked: any server can then impersonate it. Keep this for the self-signed certificate of a home broker.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Port local, écouté sur la boucle locale: Local port, bound to the loopback only, through which Jeedom passes its orders to the daemon. Change it only if that port is already taken on this machine.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Un motif par ligne, avec les jokers MQTT: One pattern per line, with the MQTT wildcards + and #. What Jeedom publishes itself is listed by default: taking it back in would mean discovering its own devices.
